newsitem.title: USA: Caribbean Cigar buys American Western Cigar.
newsitem.headline: Caribbean Cigar buys American Western Cigar.

text.p: Caribbean Cigar Co, a manufacturer and distributor of cigars and related products, said Wednesday it has acquired all the assets of American Western Cigar Co.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
American Western produces the "Celestino Vega" cigar brand under a production contract with PD Taru Martani, a handmade cigar producer in Indonesia, Caribbean Cigar said.

Carribbean Cigar said it intends to market the brand as a lower-priced, premium handmade cigar, and other brands produced by American Western, along with its own brands to meet a growing worldwide demand for cigars, said Kevin Doyle, chief executive officer of the company.

The company said that with the large production capacity of the American Western's Indonesian facility, it will obtain supplies of seven million cigars in the coming year. It said this will rise to 14 million cigars in 1998 and 20 million cigars in 1999.
As part of the deal, Caribbean Cigar has elected Alfred J. Berger Jr, formerly a principal of AWC and former president of Marsh-Weeling Cigar Co, to its board, it said.
Caribbean Cigar manufactures or markets cigars produced in Miami, the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua, Honduras and Indonesia and operates retail stores in south Florida.
